name: Swim for Life: 2022 to current
description:
This dataset records Swim for Life sessions run by NYC Parks from 2022 onward. Each row represents a scheduled class and includes the number of participants by gender category (male, female, not designated), the training entity (always NYC Parks), the training site, the borough (M for Manhattan, Q for Queens, B for Brooklyn), the class start date and time, and the class name. An adaptive_class column is present but entirely empty. Borough is missing for about 20% of rows, and most rows have zero participants in the not-designated category.

The data can be used to track participation trends over time, compare enrollment across sites and boroughs, and identify which class types or locations serve the most swimmers. It may also support reporting on program reach and planning future session capacity.
